[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Sinclair Broadcast Group is an American telecommunications conglomerate that owns numerous local television stations. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This registry row, named KOMO Plaza West, is one of two adjacent Seattle, Washington rows, KOMO Plaza East and KOMO Plaza West, roughly 30 to 40 meters apart. Per the English Wikipedia article on KOMO-TV, the two Sinclair owned Seattle television stations share studios within KOMO Plaza, formerly known as Fisher Plaza, in the Lower Queen Anne neighborhood adjacent to the Space Needle. A facility specific aggregator listing gives a single address for the complex under both the KOMO Plaza and Fisher Building names, 140 4th Avenue North, Seattle, Washington 98109, operated by a property management company as a multi-use facility. This session found no separate street addresses distinguishing an East and a West building, so this shared complex address is applied to both registry rows as likely representing two wings or towers of the same named plaza rather than two unrelated addresses.

reading.body:
KOMO Plaza West is a shared address in Lower Queen Anne, Seattle, assigned to one of two adjacent buildings within a multi-use complex that houses Sinclair Broadcast Group's television studios. The facility publishes no power specification, IT load, cooling capacity, or accelerator inventory. Without these figures, whether this site hosts meaningful AI compute capacity cannot be determined from available data.

Washington State has published power specifications for only two data center facilities totaling 60 MW across 46 mapped locations. KOMO Plaza West ranks third by published megawatts in the state, a ranking that reflects the absence of a published specification rather than a measured capacity, since the two facilities that do publish specifications account for all documented capacity in the state.

This campus matters to AI infrastructure assessment only if Sinclair Broadcast Group chooses to publish the power and cooling specifications of its Seattle facility. Until those facts appear in operator disclosures, KOMO Plaza West remains a mapped location without a measured role in the grid constraints that bind AI scaling.
